keyFindings.description: Lines 89-92 say the read is unchanged by the settlement's 'listing of a recorded comment mark and of an unrecorded one the sweep tracks', and lines 102-103 and 109-113 set up and check those marks. The listing (sweepUnrecordedMarks -> recordedMarkRefs, pmdoc.ListMarks) runs at service.go:1829, after the reuse decision at :1674-1676 and after the commit, so the helper never compares anything the listing does. The comment claims that this PR's ListMarks change is guarded by the invariant, and the fixtures have no effect. Drop the clause and the two mark fixtures, or name only the ask-block reconciliation (service.go:1615).

The bullet this PR rewrites (line 28) still points to service.go:1595-1598 for the invariant comment, which is at service.go:1669-1672 at this head. Name the comment by its place (the comment above the reuse decision in settleRoomWithin) instead of a line number.

ListMarks is exported and does not validate its input, but its result is now correct only for a tree Validate accepts. Lines 792-793 explain why the diff is safe against the replaced walk. State the precondition instead: doc must be a tree Validate accepts.

markedAnchor (lines 62-79) is a third copy of the mark-then-encode body of insertAnchoredAsk (marks_test.go:821-831) and insertAnchoredCommentWithID (marks_test.go:861-871). Move it to marks_test.go and make those two helpers call it. Its comment's 'so a settlement's anchor refresh finds the row's mark' names a settlement this test never runs.

readSnapshot.err (lines 24-27, 62-63) stores an error that cannot occur: Node.JSON fails only when Validate fails, and read comes from liveTree, already validated (pmdoc/read.go:45). Report an encoding failure with t.Errorf in afterSettleTreeRead and keep map[string][]byte.
